name: Flutterfly Dust
label: Quest
description: Flutterfly Dust: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.
Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
